Resolves #19228

ADR-0034 §2.3 gains item 8: the packaged shell's plane-attach broker pair, `planeStatus()` and `attachPlane({planeBase})`. §2.3's falsifier requires this amendment before the preload grows, and neomjs/neo-agent-institution#211 is the leaf that needs the pair: a Finder double-click boots in own-mode today, because the shell learns its plane only from environment variables.

Item 8 names what the preload may carry: both handlers validate the sender per §2.3.4, and neither reply carries credential bytes. It restates no custody rule. It cites ADR 0038 §2.1 and §2.5.1 instead: the stored record is the client connection profile in Electron-main custody, and the pair is the row-2 broker. The env seam that feeds the shell's own fleet child is marked transitional until neomjs/neo-agent-institution#17.

Evidence: L1 (a document amendment; the relative-link guard over the staged tree) → L1 required (AC-1, AC-2).
